_comment: Backdrop art mapping for The Tidal Interval. Tern Island Marine Research Station — eastern edge of a small fishing island, October storm season. Eight playable locations plus briefing/ending plates. Pixel-art keys follow the project convention (case_id _ subject _ pixel_320x320_v01.png) and are not yet rendered; this map declares the slots so the runtime can fall back to a default plate until the art is generated.
